name: Open Track Editor
tagline: Edit your GPS tracks and routes right on your phone
description:
Open Track Editor lets you edit GPS tracks directly on your Android phone, supporting common formats like GPX and KML. Trim off a wrong turn, clean up a messy recording, or tweak a route before sharing it, all without needing a computer.

It's a practical little tool for hikers, cyclists, and anyone else who records GPS tracks and wants to clean them up afterward.
